digests: Risk-off day. Semis led the drawdown, the EURUSD limit is still unfilled, gold is coiling above 2,400.
Semis dropped first and the rest of the tape followed. The cable order never filled and metals are marking time north of the round number.
The index complex gave back the open. Gold has done nothing but hold the level while the dollar decides what it is.
Flows left equities this morning. The metals bid is unchanged and the EURUSD order is still sitting there unfilled.
